text_block_list.text:
This girl's particularly hard to please. 
Total opposite of you, eh? Tray-chan.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: We're watching videos of some girls racing, that Transcend filmed. She's adding extra info that I couldn't grasp just from seeing them run.

What do you think of their running
styles? 
Anything caught you eye?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: She restarts the race footage.

They all seem to have mastered the
fundamentals. 
Their starts are good,
too. No problems there.

I agree. Then, it's gonna come down to 
their personalities, eh?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Something's missing and I can't put my finger
on it....
Transcend has shown me a lot of different girls, but none of them made me think "This is the one!"

Of course,
they're all fantastic and show a great
display of skill 
in running. Yet...
None of them have that "something..."
I don't get it. I guess it's a me problem then... I better find out what it is—

Oh, here's Wonder Acute! 
They're about to start, so pay attention!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Wah, Acute is here,
too? She's been doing really well... 
And with all those trainers looking...
I'm so nervous...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume A

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's better not to aim for first...
It might end poorly. 
I want to be in the top 5 at least,
that's easier.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume B

text_block_list.text:
Giving it your all and then falling off at
the end would be painful. 
—In the midst of watching these girls discuss
their strategies, 
a thought appeared in my mind.
Wha... Me?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well,
I think I shouldn't just be running 
for the sake of showing off... I guess?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
The point of racing is to beat the
others. 
You should be running to the point you might
stumble.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
not like I'd actually. But really though,
if you run 
safely because you want to look nice...
It'd be a bit—
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
It seems like my words connected with
her. 
I startled her for a bit,
but then she smiled back.
... Yes, exactly. It'd be boring.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Just aiming for top 5 isn't enough. 
Even going for first...
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: I want something more...
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: I want to feel the thrill of running.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaa!!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Geh! Hah... Nguh..! 
Hah... Hah... Come on!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah..! 
Gotta exceed... expectations!!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Kuuuuh!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
—This was supposed to be a mere stroll at
dusk. When I got to the vantage point,
I heard her shout 
like I hadn't heard before.
A chill went down my spine.

Worried sick, I looked for her. 
When I found her,
she was covered in sweat 
and barely able to stand up straight.

Yeah,
sorry about just now. Did I worry you? 
Thanks for keeping an eye out for me.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
She's smiling at me as if nothing
happened. 
As if she had merely pulled my leg.

Hmm? You seem worried. 
What's the matter?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Back then...? Ah... You heard me? 
Actually, it's my bad for screaming.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo embarrased.
You could've pretended 
you didn't hear anything, Tray-chan.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
I think she wanted me to hear it on
purpose. 
As to make me understand how she feels.

... Perhaps so. 
I just wish she'd put it into words.

I wonder if this relates at all to why 
I wasn't able to make my choice...
Tray-chan?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: I just want to enjoy it, y'know.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
There's only so far you can stretch
expectations. 
For especially for running,
there are limits.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
But... When I race,
I feel like I could break free from all
that. 
Just having rivals around lets me go
further!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Isn't that hella exciting?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Her words hit me hard.
Hard enough to dislodge the words 
that had been stuck at the back of my
throat...

Exceeding all expectations,
all imagination... 
We both long for a race more thrilling than
any other.

Yes, exactly. 
The best race, exceeding anything anyone 
could ever imagine.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Isn't it thrilling?
text_block_list.name: Transcend
